title: CarbonClarity: Understanding and Addressing Uncertainty in Embodied Carbon for Sustainable Computing
problem: Deterministic embodied carbon models fail to account for spatial and temporal variability in semiconductor supply chain, limiting carbon-aware design decisions.
motivation: Embodied carbon is a significant contributor to computing's carbon footprint; uncertainty quantification enables informed design choices.
method: Probabilistic framework models embodied carbon distributions across energy-per-area, gas-per-area, yield, and carbon intensity by technology node; case studies evaluate chiplet vs monolithic architectures.
key_novelty: First probabilistic embodied carbon model capturing supply chain uncertainties across multiple technology nodes.
contributions: Probabilistic framework for embodied carbon with uncertainty distributions
Quantification of embodied carbon variance across technology nodes
Evaluation of chiplet vs monolithic design carbon impact and uncertainty
Device provisioning methodology under carbon budget constraints

metrics.other: 1.6x gap between mean and 95th percentile carbon at 7nm; 18% uncertainty reduction for chiplets

limitations: Focuses on embodied carbon only, not operational carbon; assumes supply chain data accuracy; case studies limited to specific architectures.
